raw_translation: Wani kwanan wata na astronomical snapshot, ba wani Panchang ko bikin bazara/muhurta na hukuma ba. Yana amfani da wani kwanan wata na linear Lahiri ayanamsa da kuma wata yarjejeniya ta fitowar rana. Kalandan yankuna, ephemerides, tsayi, rarrabawa da kuma iyakokin hasken rana na iya bambanta. Ba ya ƙayyade ranaku na hutun, wa'adi, lokaci mai kyau ko kuma umarnin addini. Ka kwatanta sakamakon da wani Panchang na yankuna.
source: An approximate astronomical snapshot, not an official Panchang or festival/muhurta calendar. It uses a linear Lahiri ayanamsa approximation and one sunrise convention. Regional calendars, ephemerides, elevation, refraction and daylight boundaries may differ. It does not determine holidays, observances, auspicious times or religious guidance. Compare results with a regional Panchang.
translation: Wani kwanan wata na astronomical snapshot, ba wani Panchang ko bikin bazara/muhurta na hukuma ba. Yana amfani da wani kwanan wata na linear Lahiri ayanamsa da kuma wata yarjejeniya ta fitowar rana. Kalandan yankuna, ephemerides, tsayi, rarrabawa da kuma iyakokin hasken rana na iya bambanta. Ba ya ƙayyade ranaku na hutun, wa'adi, lokaci mai kyau ko kuma umarnin addini. Ka kwatanta sakamakon da wani Panchang na yankuna.

source: This inspects only the pasted certificate. It does not connect to the hostname, verify the issuer chain or revocation, or check the current server configuration.
